snippet.title: RoadCraft - Co-op Trailer
snippet.description:
Pre-order RoadCraft now: https://tinyurl.com/4h78keen

Up to 4 players with cross-play, shared progression & built-in voice chat to express your unlimited creativity together. 

Coming May 20! Pre-order now on Xbox Series X|S.
